title.confirmNew: Start a new game? Your old save will be replaced.
settings.title: Settings
char.title: Create your character
char.name: Name
prologue.1: Rain taps the train window as the last stop slides into view.
prologue.2: You haven't seen Brightfield in years.
prologue.3: In your pocket: a brass key and a letter in Grandpa's handwriting.
prologue.4: "If you're reading this, the garden is still waiting. Start at the old shed."
prologue.5: The fields are overgrown. The fence leans like a tired traveler.
prologue.6: But somewhere under the weeds, the soil remembers being green.
shed.unlock: Grandpa's brass key turns with a creak. The Old Shed is open!
shed.inside: Dusty shelves and Grandpa's old tools. (The inside comes in a later step.)
sign.farm: Brightfield Farm. Someone carved a tiny sprout under the name.
bin.empty: The Shipping Bin is empty. Bring some harvested crops here.
day.new: A new morning. Day {day} in Brightfield.
day.passedOut: You passed out in the field... You wake up tired the next morning.
quest.label: Quest: {goal}
quest.shed.till: Till the soil with the Hoe
quest.shed.plant: Plant a seed in the tilled soil
quest.shed.sell: Sell it at the Shipping Bin
quest.shed.complete: Quest complete! Grandpa's notebook opens. (+{coins}g) A chicken and 3 Animal Feed are waiting for you in the south meadow!
shop.title: Seed Shop
shop.nothing: No crops to sell right now.
npc.mina.1: Morning! I keep the Seed Shop. Your grandpa bought his first carrot seeds right here.
npc.mina.2: Rain tomorrow, they say. Good day to plant something stubborn.
npc.mina.3: If the field feels too big, start with one row. That's how he did it.
npc.rangga.1: The river behind the village is full of fish. One day I'll teach you.
npc.rangga.2: My grandmother says the soil here remembers every kind hand.
npc.rangga.3: Bring me a chili someday and I'll make you sambal you won't forget.
npc.ayu.1: You're the one from the old farm! The whole village noticed the smoke from the shed.
npc.ayu.2: We hold a harvest festival after the rains. Everyone brings something they grew.
npc.ayu.3: Coffee at my place is always warm. Just knock.
msg.needFeed: Select Animal Feed in the hotbar to feed it.
msg.animalHappy: {name} is fed and happy. Come back tomorrow!
shop.animalBought: {name} bought! It is waiting on the farm.
bag.title: {used}/{max} slots
bag.hint: Drag items to rearrange. Brighter row = your hotbar.
bag.moveHint: Now tap the slot to move it to.
item.tool: A tool. Select it on the hotbar and Tap A.
item.seed: Plant in tilled soil. Ripens in {days} days.
item.feed: Feeds one animal for a day.
skills.hint: Level up by farming, feeding animals and harvesting. More rewards are coming!
beach.arrive: Salt air and soft waves. Equip the Fishing Rod, face the water and tap A to cast.
fish.reel: Tap A in the green zone!
fish.early: Too early! The fish got scared.
fish.lost: The fish slipped off the hook!
fish.cancel: You reel the line back in.
forest.arrive: Tall trees, soft moss and mushrooms in the clearing. The forest is quiet... for now.
mine.arrive: Cool, dark and quiet. Lanterns flicker on the wall and ore glitters in the rock. Select the Pickaxe and tap A at a rock to mine it.
mine.needPickaxe: Select the Pickaxe on the hotbar to mine.
season.wither: {n} crop(s) withered in the new season.
season.last: Last day of the season! Crops that dislike the next season will wither.
notebook.closed: Grandpa's notebook is locked. Finish the Old Shed quest to open it.
notebook.title: Grandpa's Notebook
notebook.blank: This page is still blank. Keep going and it will fill in.
quest.old_shed.title: The Old Shed
quest.old_shed.desc: Grandpa left you a farm and an old shed. Learn the basics of farming.
quest.old_shed.o1: Till the soil with the Hoe
quest.old_shed.o2: Plant a seed in the tilled soil
quest.old_shed.o5: Sell it at the Shipping Bin
quest.flock.title: The Flock
quest.flock.desc: Animals need care every day. Feed an animal, then collect what it gives.
quest.first_catch.title: First Catch
quest.first_catch.desc: The sea is south of the farm. Equip the Fishing Rod and be patient.
quest.explorer.title: Explorer
quest.explorer.desc: Know your land: visit the beach, the forest and the mine.
quest.rock_collector.title: Stone & Copper
quest.rock_collector.desc: Bring home ore from the mine. The rocks grow back every day.
quest.kitchen_table.title: The Kitchen
quest.kitchen_table.desc: Cook any dish at the Kitchen north of the field. Salt is sold in its pantry.
quest.green_thumb.title: Green Thumb
quest.green_thumb.desc: Harvest crops. Mind the seasons: not every seed grows in every season.
quest.new_season.title: Wheel Turns
quest.new_season.desc: A season lasts 28 days. Keep farming until the next one begins.
quest.secret.title: The Last Page
quest.secret.desc: Finish the other pages, then ask Ayu in the village about the harvest festival.
quest.mina_eggs.title: Mina's Eggs
quest.mina_eggs.desc: Mina needs fresh eggs for the shop's baking.
quest.mina_eggs.offer: Could you bring me 3 fresh Eggs? I will pay you well.
quest.mina_eggs.thanks: Perfect, these are fresh! Here is your payment.
quest.rangga_fish.title: Fresh Fish
quest.rangga_fish.desc: Rangga wants fish for dinner. Any fish will do.
quest.rangga_fish.offer: Got any fish? Bring me 2 and I will make it worth your while.
quest.rangga_fish.thanks: Mmm, what a catch! Thank you.
quest.rangga_fish.remind: I am still hungry for 2 fish.
quest.ayu_sambal.title: Ayu's Sambal
quest.ayu_sambal.desc: Ayu loves spicy food. Cook her a Sambal.
quest.ayu_sambal.offer: I heard you can cook! Bring me a Sambal and I will be grateful.
quest.ayu_sambal.thanks: So spicy and so good! Thank you, truly.
quest.ayu_sambal.remind: Sambal, remember? Chili, tomato and salt.
notebook.old_shed.hint: Start at the shed by the field. Every farm begins with one seed.
notebook.old_shed.story: I built this farm from one seed and a lot of patience. Till, plant, water, harvest. The rest of this book will open as you grow.
notebook.flock.hint: Animals need feed every day. Feed one, then collect what it gives.
notebook.flock.story: A fed hen is a happy hen. Care for them every morning and the farm repays you every evening.
notebook.first_catch.hint: The beach is south of the farm. Equip the rod and wait for the bite. Catch 3 fish.
notebook.first_catch.story: Fishing taught me patience better than farming ever did. Wait for the bite, then tap at the right moment.
notebook.explorer.hint: Visit the beach (south), the forest (north) and the mine.
notebook.explorer.story: Brightfield is more than a field: sea to the south, forest to the north, and a mine hiding riches under the hill.
notebook.rock_collector.hint: The mine grows its rocks back every day. Bring home 5 Stone and a Copper Ore.
notebook.rock_collector.story: Good tools come from good ore. I never found the gold seam. Maybe you will.
notebook.kitchen_table.hint: Buy salt in the Kitchen pantry and cook any dish.
notebook.kitchen_table.story: A meal cooked from your own harvest tastes better than gold.
notebook.green_thumb.hint: Harvest 10 crops. Mind the seasons: each seed likes certain seasons only.
notebook.green_thumb.story: Spring seeds, summer sun, autumn gold. Learn the seasons and the soil will answer.
notebook.new_season.hint: A season lasts 28 days. Rain waters your crops for you, but crops that dislike the new season wither.
notebook.new_season.story: Rain on the fields is a gift: it waters everything while you sleep. Plan around the seasons and the weather.
notebook.secret.hint: When the other pages are done, talk to Ayu in the village about the harvest festival.
notebook.secret.story: The harvest festival was my favourite day of the year. Ayu will remember. Look after Brightfield, and each other. Grandpa
